blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Amid geopolitical challenges impacting agricultural production, the Department of Agriculture (DA) called for regional cooperation and enhanced market linkages to secure food supplies across Southeast Asia. Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. said establishing robust trade frameworks and mutual economic investments within ASEAN are crucial to bridging supply gaps during domestic production challenges. READ: Asean urged to boost food security amid risks Tiu Laurel proposed expanding the “Big Brother, Small Brother” concept across the regional bloc.
